name: arch-citation-gate
description: Owns exactly one methodology: the sourcing norm (issue-1's citation-format rule, generalized) — every phase-1 proposal or phase-2 record claim phrased as external/industry knowledge must carry a URL or a Sources: entry. Fires on docs/issue-<n>/proposals/*.md and docs/issue-<n>/reports/architecture.md writes, shared unchanged across both phases. Resulting-content computation, fail-closed. Kill switch: ARCH_CITATION_GATE_OFF=1.
